data.name: Seagull Simulator
data.detailed_description:
You're a Seagull. Act Like it.

No rules. No mercy. No regard for anyone's lunch. Dive into a physics-driven open world and cause as much chaos as your little wings can carry. Steal, harass, crash, and squawk your way through a world that was absolutely not built to handle you.




The World is Your Victim
Every person you meet is an opportunity. Chase them down, snatch whatever they're holding, and send them running. NPCs have feelings — and ruining them is kind of the whole point. The more chaos you cause, the more the world reacts.


But Sometimes... They Fight Back

Not everyone will take it lying down. Get too bold and you might find yourself on the wrong end of an angry beachgoer. Know when to swoop in — and when to get out of there fast.




Features

  • Fly, run, and crash through a handcrafted open world

  • Steal food, knock over props, and terrorize NPCs

  • Physics-based interactions — if it can be pushed, you can push it

  • Complete objectives or just ignore them and cause problems

  • Dynamic NPC reactions that escalate the more chaos you cause

  • Hidden secrets for those who look a little closer...

  • More locations, mechanics, and mayhem coming as development continues

This is Just the Beginning

The game is still in development and growing fast. Wishlist now to follow along and be the first to know when it's ready to ruin your afternoon.

👉 Add to Wishlist — your future victims are counting on you.
